remarks: Located in the heart of Norwalk, CT, North Seven combines community, nature, and forward momentum in an urban environment. Our cat-friendly luxury apartments boast impeccable modern layouts with new stainless-steel appliances, including an in-unit full-size Washer and Dryer, wood-finish laminate flooring, Granite countertops, kitchen island. 1 Glover offers numerous amenities that act as an extension of your home and help you add variety and quality to your day-to-day life. Take in a breath of fresh air with any of the numerous courtyards and outdoor spaces available, which includes fire pits, grilling stations, a pool, and resort-style outdoor lounges. Enjoy games and entertainment in The Club Room, which includes a kitchen, perfect for entertaining. In addition to offering loads of amenities, there are year-round events perfect for socializing and getting to know your neighbors. One Glover has easy access to major transit, fine dining, entertainment, and retail.
